description: This file defines a mock class 'MediaPipelineCapabilitiesMock' for the 'IMediaPipelineCapabilities' interface, used in unit testing to simulate media pipeline capabilities, including methods to get supported MIME types and check MIME type support.

classes.name: MediaPipelineCapabilitiesMock
classes.description: A mock implementation of IMediaPipelineCapabilities for testing purposes.

methods.name: getSupportedMimeTypes
methods.description: Returns a list of supported MIME types for a given media source type.

methods.name: isMimeTypeSupported
methods.description: Checks if a specific MIME type is supported.
